pay.title: Confirm and pay the deposit
pay.desc: Mock payment for the thesis demo — no real money is captured. This charges the 15% construction deposit only, not a material-store quote.
pay.confirmBody: Simulated gateway for the thesis. No real money is captured. BuildMate will record a 15% hold; the contractor has not received the 5% yet.
pay.success: Deposit paid successfully. Your construction order has been confirmed.
pay.retryHint: Payment did not go through. You can try again on this page.
pay.paidHint: Deposit placed. BuildMate is holding it (mock). This does not mean the contractor has been paid.
pay.mockNote: Simulated thesis transaction — not a real money transfer.
pay.termsBox: I have read and agree: the 15% deposit is held by BuildMate (mock); a customer cancellation after deposit may forfeit the hold under the accepted terms pending verification; a contractor cancellation refunds the full 15%; a dispute freezes escrow. This is not a real money transfer.
